title: [Seken no Katasumi (Kaeruyama Yoshitaka)]Seiheki Yaba bakunyū on'na kara `30-bu dake suki ni shasei shihōdai-ken' o watasa reta sei de shōki o ushinainagara atama kurukuru pā pyuppyu o shite shimau dōtei-tachi no hanashi
